patch_description: The best prior result used only translation and global-scale normalization rather than constraining every point to the unit sphere. A diameter-packing optimum is not generally cospherical, so the per-point projection removes useful radial degrees of freedom. This edit changes the existing normalization helper to center the configuration and fix only its RMS radius, while changing momentum/gradient projection to remove just translation and global scaling. The cube-axis seed is also rescaled so its axis vertices initially lie on the same radius as cube vertices.
